entities.name: Yada'il Dharih I.
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yada'il Dharih I, son of Sumuhu'ali I was a Sabaean ruler (mukarrib). His reign was placed around 660 BC by Hermann von Wissmann and around 490–470 BC by Kenneth Kitchen.
